End Users.Title: User Account Management
End Users.Description: Provide functionalities for users to create and manage their accounts, enabling secure SignUp and SignIn processes, and allowing users to update and edit their profile information post-login.

End Users.Title: Wishlist Creation and Management
End Users.Description: Enable authenticated users to create and manage a personal wishlist, adding and modifying items or interests as desired within their user profile.

End Users.Title: Landing Page Development
End Users.Description: Develop a visually appealing and informative landing page that effectively guides users to SignUp or SignIn, and provides direct access to edit profile and create wishlist functionalities.

Business Owners.Title: User Account Management
Business Owners.Description: Develop secure and intuitive user account management functionalities including SignUp and SignIn, allowing users to register, access, and manage their accounts, thus driving user engagement and platform security.

Business Owners.Title: User Profile Customization
Business Owners.Description: Create functionalities for users to edit and update their profiles post-registration, enabling personalized user experiences which can improve user satisfaction and retention.

Business Owners.Title: Wishlist Creation
Business Owners.Description: Implement a feature for users to create and manage personalized wishlists, enhancing user interaction and engagement with the platform, which can lead to increased user retention and satisfaction.

Business Owners.Title: Landing Page Development
Business Owners.Description: Design and implement an inviting and informative landing page that directs users efficiently to either sign up, sign in, or access their profiles and wishlists, thereby increasing conversion rates and enhancing user experience.

System Administrators.Title: User Management System
System Administrators.Description: Develop a robust user management system to handle SignUp, SignIn, and user authentication processes, ensuring secure access controls and management capabilities for administrators.

System Administrators.Title: Profile Management System
System Administrators.Description: Implement a system that allows administrators to manage and oversee user profile information, including the ability to edit, update, or remove user profiles as necessary.

System Administrators.Title: Wishlist Management Module
System Administrators.Description: Create a module that enables administrators to manage user wishlists, including adding, editing, or deleting wishlist items, and to oversee how these lists are used and managed within the application.

System Administrators.Title: Security and Compliance Enforcement
System Administrators.Description: Ensure the web application adheres to relevant security standards and data protection regulations, implementing necessary security measures to protect user data and system integrity.

System Administrators.Title: System Monitoring and Reporting
System Administrators.Description: Develop a comprehensive system monitoring and reporting framework that allows administrators to monitor system performance, user activities, and security logs to ensure smooth operations.
